svg.title: 04 Olive Mountain — multi-source living botanical copperplate, V2
svg.desc: Four distinct and traceable engraved source families, not twelve stamped copies: archival olive leaves and fruit from OpenClipart item 81199, the Walter Crane / johnny_automatic public-domain historical engraving, original west-side tree intaglio, and original Mount of Olives Jerusalem landscape contour study. Layered with eighteen individually composed growing structural paths, and staged by scrolling. The existing OS olive green and morning gold are supplied by CSS.
svg.metadata: Source and rights register: docs/design/OLIVE-MOUNTAIN-ART-SOURCES.md; OpenClipart 81199 public domain; Walter Crane Line and Form / OpenClipart 7331 public domain; westsidewatch authored V11 and V8 plates. Original V1–V13 files remain untouched. Artwork is preliminary, not visually accepted.
